verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas scripts attach to entities to define behaviors, handle user input and manage game logic, so event-driven actions can be built in code. ESM class-based scripts are the recommended way to do this, and an Editor API supports programmatic automation. The evidence does not show a declarative rules or trigger system; automation means writing code, and event hooks are only implied. Missing for 10: a documented event/trigger system (e.g. collision or input event APIs), a declarative or no-code rule definition, and hands-on corroboration of event-triggered automation.
